settings.site_key_help: From your client area. It is bound to this domain — the same key will not work on another site.
settings.moderation_help: Most posts are cleared instantly and for free. Only genuinely ambiguous ones are looked at more closely, and nothing is ever removed automatically — anything questionable is queued for you.
settings.answers_help: Members can ask, and get an answer drawn from your own discussions. When nothing on your forum answers the question, it says so rather than guessing.
settings.trusted_posts_label: Trust members after this many posts
settings.threshold_help: Below this, Steward says it does not know rather than answering from a weak match. 0.62 suits most forums.
